header.title: Facility settings
header.description: Maintain the healthcare organization, branch identity, document branding, public portal content, and print defaults used across VIARA.

status.title: Configuration status
status.savedHelp: The form matches the currently loaded facility configuration.
status.unsavedHelp: Review and save before leaving this page.

organization.title: Organization identity
organization.description: The healthcare provider identity inherited by reports, invoices, receipts, stickers, labels, and portals.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Logo variants and colors used by the identity resolver, print templates, and portal surfaces.
branding.presetsDescription: Apply a coordinated clinical palette across the facility interface.

contact.title: Contact information
contact.description: Public and document-safe contact details inherited by branches when no override exists.

legal.title: Legal and billing
legal.description: Identifiers used by invoices, receipts, report footers, and regulated documents.

branches.title: Multi-Branch & Medical Chains Management
branches.description: Comprehensive management of radiology branch network, primary headquarters, satellite clinics, independent licenses, equipment modalities, and operating hours.
branches.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this branch? This action cannot be undone.
branches.cannotDeleteMain: Cannot delete the primary headquarters branch. Please set another primary branch first.
branches.searchPlaceholder: Search by branch name, code, city, manager...
branches.emptyStateDesc: Add your healthcare facilities and diagnostic branches for centralized management.

modal.codeHint: Unique branch code identifier (e.g., MDI-01, DKI-02).
modal.managerHint: Primary operational or medical director for this location.
modal.isMainLabel: Set this location as the Primary Headquarters (Primary HQ)
modal.isMainHint: The central facility record will synchronize with this branch's details.
modal.modalitiesHint: Select diagnostic imaging modalities available at this location for appointment scheduling.
modal.hoursOverride: Override operating hours for this specific branch
modal.reportHeaderOverride: Custom Report Header for this Branch (HTML / Text)
modal.reportHeaderHint: Leave empty to inherit the organization's central report header.
modal.reportFooterOverride: Custom Report Footer for this Branch (HTML / Text)

portal.title: Portal identity
portal.description: Portal shell uses organization identity; individual appointments and studies can still show originating branch identity.
portal.openBuilder: Customize the public page in Portal Builder

profile.title: Facility profile
profile.description: Identity and contact details used across administrative, patient-facing, reporting, billing, and printing documents.
profile.invoiceExampleHint: Illustrative formatting only; this is not the next invoice number.

fields.centerNameHint: Required organization name displayed throughout the system.
fields.logoUrlHint: Main logo used in printouts and public pages.
fields.contactPersonHint: Primary operational contact for this branch.
fields.otherDetailsHint: Accreditation, registration, floor, or branch-specific notes.
fields.invoicePrefixHint: Short prefix placed before generated invoice numbers.
fields.vatEnabled: Enable VAT / tax settings on financial documents
fields.showPoweredByViara: Show Powered by VIARA where licensing allows

homepage.title: Public homepage
homepage.description: Customize the public radiology center website shown before login. These fields are safe to publish.
homepage.publishHelp: When disabled, the public page still shows essential contact details and secure portal links.
homepage.announcementHint: Short top-line text above the hero title.
homepage.heroImageHint: Use a direct image path or URL. Leave the default scan montage for a ready-made visual.
homepage.servicesHint: One service per line. Format: Title | Description
homepage.statsHint: One stat per line. Format: Value | Label
homepage.highlightsHint: One short highlight per line. These appear under the hero CTA.
homepage.securityNote: Public homepage settings are shared with the unauthenticated website only; internal report, receipt, and billing settings stay protected.

hours.title: Operating hours
hours.description: Define the facility-wide scheduling window using whole hours in 24-hour time.
hours.hourHint: Enter a whole hour from 0 to 24.
hours.invalid: Opening and closing hours must be between 0 and 24.
hours.operationalNote: Appointment availability also considers configured resources, existing bookings, holidays retained in the settings record, and equipment downtime.
hours.workingDaysDescription: Choose the days available for patient scheduling and appointment booking.
hours.holidaysDescription: Add holiday exceptions that booking schedules should observe.
hours.holidayPlaceholder: Add a holiday, for example Friday or Eid al-Fitr
hours.noHolidays: No holiday dates have been added.

documents.title: Document and invoice settings
documents.description: Configure report headers, footers, and safe document text used by generated reports and billing documents.
documents.htmlHint: Maximum 500 characters. Stored exactly as entered.
documents.headerPlaceholder: Facility name, logo markup, or report heading...
documents.footerPlaceholder: Contact details, accreditation text, or disclaimer...
documents.emptyHeader: Report header content will appear here.
documents.emptyFooter: Report footer content will appear here.
documents.tagHint: Select a placeholder to insert it into the report header.
documents.previewDescription: Preview the configured logo, colors, tax identifiers, and disclaimers.
documents.defaultDisclaimer: No custom disclaimer. The system default will be used.

printing.title: Printing preferences
printing.description: Customize sticker dimensions, receipt content, report branding, invoice terms, and print previews.
printing.showQr: Display QR code for portal login on receipts
printing.invoiceTermsPlaceholder: Terms of payment, refund policy, etc...

states.errorDescription: The current facility configuration could not be loaded. No settings can be edited until the connection is restored.
states.refreshError: The latest settings could not be refreshed
states.showingSaved: The last successfully loaded configuration remains visible.

messages.saveFailed: Facility settings could not be updated
messages.logoImageOnly: Use PNG, JPG, SVG, or WebP for logos.
messages.logoTooLarge: Logo image must be smaller than 800 KB.
messages.logoInvalid: The selected file does not look like a supported image.
messages.logoReadFailed: Logo image could not be read.

previews.title: Branding previews
previews.description: Preview how facility identity appears in documents and the patient portal.
previews.inheritedDisclaimer: The organization disclaimer will be used.
previews.billingTerms: Billing terms and tax details will appear here.
previews.portalWelcome: Welcome to the Radiology Patient Portal
